subject: Taxes
title: DAO Taxation Puzzle
description: A short lesson to help you apply DAO Taxation Puzzle.

hook.text: A DAO has no CEO, no office, and no country. It's code run by token holders.

buildup.text: DAOs manage billions in assets through community votes.

discovery.text: The IRS treats unincorporated DAOs as partnerships by default.

twist.text: Most DAO token holders have no idea they might owe taxes on DAO activities.

climax.text: DAOs challenge tax law's most basic assumption: that taxable entities have borders, owners, and legal structures.

punchline.text: No CEO, no country, billions in assets. DAOs broke the concept of a taxpayer.

quiz.question: How does the IRS default to treating DAOs?
options: As partnerships, making token holders potentially liable
